critique.change: At shot-08s replace the overplotted dark strokes in the core with fewer slate node fills and dimmed halos so the stagnant pocket reads as a shaped region with a clear edge rather than scribble.
Add a second rendering idea such as shaded tube depth or soft occlusion on shielded tips, so shot-02s and shot-08s show shelter as light falling off inside the colony, not only as line colour.
Enlarge the 20 cm/s tick and dial readout and let the dial visibly cross it at 6 s, so the threshold reads from the frame itself, not from the small caption at the bottom edge.
